data.name: AICOMI
data.detailed_description:
┏―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―┓

    Create your own personalized classroom full of dream girls

    with an incredibly detailed character creation system, then

    romance them to your heart's content!

┗―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―┛

Head to the Japanese countryside in ILLGAMES' newest game, AICOMI!

Experience a relaxing, cozy, and sedate life in the retro environs of a small Japanese town. Watch fireflies, take a dip in the river, and enjoy everything the pastoral beauty of this secluded town has to offer!

Moving to a new town and transferring schools is never easy, especially if you're doing it all by your lonesome. Luckily, you've got the positive attitude to make a healthy, fresh start of it! Brimming with vim and vigor, you step into your new classroom...only to discover that you're the only guy in the entire school! Shock! Awe! ...Opportunity? Befriend a bevy of beautiful girls, develop your relationships, and become acquaintances, friends, and perhaps even something more...?

AICOMI means ""Love Communication,"" so let that motto guide you! Create the girl(s!) of your dreams, delight in their presence, and fall in love in this delectable romance simulation game!

┏―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―┓

    Beautifully Crafted 3D Maps!

┗―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―┛

Every location in the peaceful environs of your new hometown has been lovingly rendered into detail-rich fully 3D maps. Walk, run, interact, and chat as you explore the many facets of the Japanese countryside.

Immerse yourself in a wide variety of unique locations, such as the school, the town, and various special spots in the local fields and backroads. Encounter your fellow classmates in their natural habitats, and remember to always savor chance encounters, for you never know where they might lead!

┏―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―┓

    A Rich Array of Characters With Tons of Unique Dialogue!

┗―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―━―┛

AICOMI features the greatest quantity and variety of conversation patterns to date!

Whether it be casual classroom gossip or deeply romantic date discussions, this game offers a tremendous amount of carefully crafted dialogue for you to enjoy. Each of the 20—yes, 20!—different character archetypes has thousands of lines of unique dialogue, with multiple variations to fit unique situations and to keep things fresh and fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 / 11 (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100 serise or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 Series or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 Series (VRAM 3GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires an Internet connection.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 / 11 (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-8700 serise or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 Series or AMD Radeon™ RX 480 Series (VRAM 6GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires an Internet connection.
